field_reviews.explanation: The document explicitly places this route in pretraining: the figure caption says "pretraining on representation-learning tasks" and the pipeline section describes Stage 1 pretraining.
The quoted configuration is stated verbatim in Figure 1: multi-modal biological data, including PPI databases, is tokenized, encoded, and aligned to Qwen.
"protein-protein interaction databases" are named directly as one of the input modalities in the figure caption.
The document states the data "is tokenized and passed through a transformer encoder" and then "aligned to a Qwen" backbone, which matches the asserted chain.

The document shows the databases are tokenized before model intake, but it does not establish that the model-visible form is the databases themselves; it only supports a text-tokenized representation.
A text-native carrier is supported by the tokenization/transformer wording, but the more specific subtype "structured_biological_prompt_or_task_scaffold" is not established anywhere for this route.
The route is explicitly described as being tokenized, passed through a transformer encoder, and aligned to the Qwen backbone.
The document indicates some form of alignment into the Qwen backbone, but it does not specify the insertion topology well enough to justify the exact label "shared_latent_alignment".
This is biological data used in the pretraining pipeline, so its role as model input/payload is established even though the route uses a custom label.
The route is part of the training pipeline and the figure explicitly says the data is tokenized and fed into the encoder, so it is an actual model input.

supporting_quotes: "is tokenized and passed through a transformer encoder"
reviews.concise_rationale: The route is well supported as pretraining input for tokenized multimodal biological data, but the asserted visible form and the exact fusion topology are not established; the carrier subtype is also too specific for the evidence provided.
